name: Missionaries
overview: Scripture commands believers to actively make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, as demonstrated in the Great Commission (Matthew 28:19). Jesus exemplifies personal witness by instructing the healed man to share the Lord's compassionate works with others (Mark 5:19). Empowered by the Holy Spirit, believers are called to be witnesses locally and globally, extending to the ends of the earth (Acts 1:8). Ultimately, God will reward each person according to their deeds, underscoring the importance of faithful service in missionary work (Romans 2:6).
